verdict.rationale: First-party support docs explicitly describe a self-service flow: view current limits under Accounts → Limits and request an increase directly from that screen, with related help articles confirming the limits view. This matches the finance-lead story closely. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that limit-increase requests are actually approved smoothly (one community review vaguely mentions 'problems with prescribed limits'), and no explicit persona-specific (finance-lead role) detail.
